description: This file defines a data transfer object (DTO) class 'ClaimAttachmentSearchFilterParams' within the OrangeHRM Claim module. It extends a base FilterParams class and introduces a requestId property with getter and setter methods, used for filtering claim attachments during searches.

classes.name: ClaimAttachmentSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class used to encapsulate filter parameters when searching for claim attachments, specifically including a requestId property.

methods.name: getRequestId
methods.description: Returns the request ID associated with the filter, null if not set.

methods.name: setRequestId
methods.description: Sets the request ID for the filter parameters.
